title: Task lead per task: per-task coordinator session (guard profile lead = main's rights on one task), replaced from the checkpoint when it runs out of turns; main only dispatches [RAW-00490; needs TASK-096]
requirement: WHEN a task is active, a task lead SHALL run it with main's rights limited to that task, and a new lead SHALL resume from the task checkpoint when one runs out. REQ-0061
